_comment: Named camera presets. Every preset is rendered on `make shot` and diffed against shots/golden/. `overview` is the primary composition check; the others exist so a change that fixes one framing but breaks another is visible immediately.

presets.name: overview
presets._comment: Matches the reference framing: high oblique, ~40 degrees down, wide enough to read the whole landmass silhouette.

presets.name: coast
presets._comment: Low and close on the shoreline - the sea/land transition and foam are hard to judge from the overview.

presets.name: ridge
presets._comment: Side-on across the mountains to check silhouette, rock texturing and shadow length.
